status_values.ok: the complete bidirectional sequence-likelihood result is available

progen2_score.description: negative average of the forward and reverse sums of chunk-level mean NLL, divided by terminalized sequence length; summed across mutated chains

bidirectional_mean_nll.description: per-chain mean of forward_mean_nll and reverse_mean_nll; summed across mutated chains

forward_mean_nll.description: forward_nll_sum divided by forward_token_count per chain; summed across mutated chains

reverse_mean_nll.description: reverse_nll_sum divided by reverse_token_count per chain; summed across mutated chains

forward_nll_sum.description: sum of forward amino-acid token negative log likelihoods

reverse_nll_sum.description: sum of reverse amino-acid token negative log likelihoods

forward_chunk_mean_nll_sum.description: sum of forward mean NLL over context chunks

reverse_chunk_mean_nll_sum.description: sum of reverse mean NLL over context chunks

progen2_delta.description: mutant ProGen2 score minus the corresponding wild-type chain score

cache.granularity: wild-type chain plus unique complete variant sequence
